text:
izzy: Quick sync: perf ran a mixed workload and we hit lots of small pinned host pages that prevent arena coalescing. Host staging keeps growing even after gen completes.

rahul: any traces? sounds like classic fragmentation where frees are non-contiguous.

izzy: pasted small excerpt of allocation heatmap in the perf run: most freed slots are scattered, leaving tiny gaps. We tried immediate compaction but it stalls the worker. Can't afford pauses at tail-latency.

mina: two knobs: (A) opportunistic coalesce on free (cheap, incremental), (B) background stitcher that runs during low-qps. Also a contiguous-available estimate for admission.

rahul: agree. opportunistic coalesce helps amortize work. But we should also add a "stitch reserve": small reserved block per-arena used only for stitching runs, so we rarely need global compaction.

izzy: stitch reserve sounds low-risk. How big? 1MB per 32GB arena? we need benchmarks.

mina: propose default reserve = max(256KB, arena_size/32768). We'll add config flag.

rahul: admission change: before granting a large pin (>128KB) require contiguous_estimate >= requested_size. If not, offer streaming-pin mode where request gets a token and we stream in chunks pinned lazily.

izzy: streaming-pin tradeoff: client needs to handle partial availability. We'll add server-side helper to assemble live view for generators so they can proceed without full pin.

mina: telemetry: add gauge host_staging_fragmentation_ratio (1 - largest_free_run / resident) and host_staging_contig_est_bytes. Also counter admission_streamed and admission_rejected_contig.

rahul: alert: fragmentation_ratio > 0.35 for 3m -> page-coalesce advisory P3. Also instrument compaction durations and work bytes.

izzy: unit tests: simulate interleaved small frees with a long pinned allocation to check the reserve and streaming fallback. Also a race test for opportunistic coalesce concurrency.

mina: implementation sketch:
```
Allocator.Free(addr):
  add to free-list
  try opportunistic_coalesce(local_run)
  if local_run.size >= reserve_threshold: mark arena.low_frag

Allocator.RequestPin(size, mode):
  if size >= big_threshold and contiguous_estimate < size:
    if mode == immediate: return reject
    else: return streaming_token
```

rahul: one more: add telemetry schema_version on emitted events so rolling deploys don't reorder fields and create miscounts.

ops-bot: created perf job: stitch-reserve-eval-20240523 (id: job-20240523-09)

izzy: next steps: mina will prototype opportunistic coalesce and stitch reserve; rahul will add admission+streaming API and tests; i'll add telemetry fields and alert. Revisit after perf job completes.
